steps.title: Prepare EGM‑2 complete medium
steps.instruction: Follow the Lonza BulletKit instructions, add fetal bovine serum to a final concentration of 2 % (v/v) to the EGM‑2 basal medium, mix, and store the complete medium at 4 °C.

steps.title: Make 10 mM PP2 stock solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 6 mg PP2 into a sterile microcentrifuge tube, dissolve in 2 mL DMSO in the laminar flow hood, vortex briefly, aliquot 50 µL portions, and store aliquots at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 200 µM PP2 (PP2‑20X)
steps.instruction: Thaw one 10 mM PP2 aliquot in a 37 °C water bath, add 2 µL of the thawed stock to 100 µL basal EBM‑2 medium (no serum or growth factors), vortex vigorously to obtain a 200 µM solution, keep on ice, and discard any remaining solution.

steps.title: Prepare vehicle control (VEH‑20X)
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL DMSO to 100 µL basal EBM‑2 medium, vortex vigorously to obtain a 2 % (v/v) DMSO solution, keep on ice, and discard any remaining solution.

steps.title: Rehydrate BioCoat T‑25 and T‑75 flasks
steps.instruction: Bring the collagen‑coated flasks to room temperature, add 5 mL warm RPMI‑1640 to the T‑25 and 15 mL to the T‑75, incubate 2 h at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂, aspirate the medium, then add 10 mL (T‑25) or 20 mL (T‑75) EGM‑2 complete medium.

steps.title: Thaw and seed cryopreserved HRMECs
steps.instruction: Thaw a vial of HRMECs in a 37 °C water bath, wipe dry, rinse with 70 % ethanol, transfer to the hood, dispense the cell suspension into the rehydrated T‑25 and T‑75 flasks using a 1 mL sterile serological pipette, rinse the vial with 1 mL EGM‑2 complete medium and add to the flasks; seed at 6 000 cells cm⁻², place flasks flat in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator and do not disturb for 24 h.

steps.title: Replace medium after initial attachment
steps.instruction: After 24 h, aspirate the medium from each flask and add fresh EGM‑2 complete medium to remove residual DMSO and unattached cells.

steps.title: Maintain and subculture HRMECs
steps.instruction: Change medium every 3 days. When cultures reach 70‑80 % confluence, subculture as follows:

substeps.instruction: Rinse flasks with DPBS (5 mL for T‑25, 10 mL for T‑75).
Add 0.25 % Trypsin‑EDTA (2 mL for T‑25, 3 mL for T‑75) and rock gently.
Incubate 1–2 min at 37 °C until cells round up; tap flasks if needed.
Neutralize trypsin with 1 mL (T‑25) or 2 mL (T‑75) FBS.
Rinse the flask surface with 10 mL DPBS, collect the rinse, and combine all cell suspension in a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate supernatant, gently flick the pellet, and resuspend cells in 1 mL EGM‑2 complete medium.
Count cells with a hemocytometer and adjust the suspension to 1.6 × 10⁷ cells mL⁻¹ (Tube A).

steps.title: Prepare Matrigel for the assay
steps.instruction: Thaw the required amount of PR‑containing or PR‑free Matrigel overnight at 4 °C, keep all aliquots, pipette tips and tubes on ice, and store Matrigel on ice throughout the experiment. Trim pipette tips to increase bore, dip tips in ice‑cold RPMI‑1640 before use.

steps.title: Day 1 – assemble cell‑drug‑Matrigel mixtures
steps.instruction: All tubes are kept on ice:

substeps.instruction: Mix 45 µL of Tube A cell suspension with 5 µL PP2‑20X (200 µM) → Tube B (final PP2 20 µM).
Mix 45 µL of Tube A with 5 µL VEH‑20X (2 % DMSO) → Tube B‑VEH (final DMSO 0.2 %).
Flick tubes gently (no vortex) to mix.
Combine 20 µL of Tube B with 20 µL Matrigel → Tube C (final PP2 10 µM).
Combine 20 µL of Tube B‑VEH with 20 µL Matrigel → Tube C‑VEH (final DMSO 0.1 %).

steps.title: Plate primary Matrigel layer
steps.instruction: Place an 8‑well chamber slide in a dish with tissue paper inside the hood, prevent the slide from sticking, then add 6 µL of Tube C as a central drop into each well (duplicate wells). Repeat with Tube C‑VEH for control wells. Incubate 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to allow polymerization.

steps.title: Add medium after primary polymerization
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL EGM‑2 complete medium to each well and incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Day 2 – overlay secondary Matrigel layer
steps.instruction: Prepare secondary matrix by mixing equal volumes of PR‑free Matrigel and EGM‑2 medium containing 4 % FBS (keep on ice). Observe the primary drop under a phase‑contrast microscope, then:

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the medium from each well carefully without disturbing the primary drop.
Overlay 200 µL of the chilled 1:1 PR‑free Matrigel/EGM‑2 mixture onto each well.
Incubate 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to polymerize the secondary layer.
Add 250 µL EGM‑2 complete medium to each well and incubate another 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Day 3 – imaging and data acquisition
steps.instruction: Examine wells with a phase‑contrast microscope, capture three independent fields per sample at 10× magnification.

substeps.instruction: Open the images in Adobe Illustrator 2023, draw a dotted line across the interface between primary and secondary layers.
Export the annotated images as JPEGs via Adobe Photoshop 2023.

Open JPEGs in ImageJ, use the line tool to draw six measurement lines from the primary layer into the secondary layer, pressing Ctrl‑M after each line to record its length; stop drawing when a gap larger than two cells is encountered.
Collect all length measurements.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of sprouting data
steps.instruction: Import the length data into GraphPad Prism 9, create a column graph, and perform an unpaired non‑parametric t‑test followed by a Mann‑Whitney post‑test (P ≤ 0.05) to compare treatment versus control.
